responsive.web: copy left; dominant personal-surface portrait right
responsive.tablet: portrait expands into dominant right field; copy may overlap visual field
responsive.mobile: identity/name/formula first; portrait below at full content width

eventPresentation.responsiveRule: reuse one approved event image and crop it; never invent a new composition per breakpoint
eventPresentation.detailRelation: Dementor is rendered as a related entity with personal background, not as a second hero

homePresentation.heroMediaRole: right-side hero media, never a detached downstream figure
homePresentation.heroCropPolicy: retain the complete approved illustration on desktop; breathing room is preferred to cropping
homePresentation.desktop: copy left; media occupies the right field inside the first screen
homePresentation.mobile: copy first; the same media remains inside the hero below the copy

listPresentation.rule: selected, hover or focus accent surface spans the full viewport width while row content remains aligned to the page grid
appliesTo: entity registers where an accent row is used
